charts.title: How the water question was put to observers' site calls, and how it came out.
charts.takeaway: Decline was about as common on wet sites as on dry ones: adjusted odds ratio 1.11 (0.65 to 1.75). Neither direction passed, so the result is undecided.
charts.n: 912 cedars with a site description, 169 on wet sites and 743 on upland sites, in 294 cells of 5 km

steps.label: 912 cedars with a site call
steps.detail: Community observations with a hydrology answer, 2020 to 2022: 87 of 169 declining on wet sites, 347 of 743 on upland sites.

steps.label: Odds ratio, wet against dry
steps.detail: Adjusted for site type, disturbance and year. A value of 1 means the same odds of decline on wet and dry sites.

steps.label: Control: labels shuffled within site
steps.detail: Health labels shuffled inside each 5 km cell, 1,000 times. The within-cell odds ratio of 0.95 sits inside the shuffle's 5th to 95th percentile range, 0.61 to 1.63.

steps.label: Rule: one direction must pass
steps.detail: Supported if wet sites show more decline on the primary measure with its observer check; opposed if they show less; otherwise undecided.

steps.label: Neither direction passed
steps.detail: The interval leaves an odds ratio of 1.5 open either way, and declining observations answered the water question 12.3 points more often than healthy ones, against a limit of 5.

charts.title: Odds of decline or stress on wet sites against dry ones, every measure.
charts.takeaway: Every cedar interval crosses 1. Only maple on water-flagged park plots lies wholly below 1, and maple's second water measure does not.
charts.units: adjusted odds ratio, wet against dry (1 means the same odds; above 1 means more decline or stress on wet sites)
charts.n: 912 cedars on the primary measure (169 wet); the number of wet-site trees for each measure is in the table
charts.interval: 95% cluster-bootstrap interval, the exponential of the stored log values
charts.baseline: An odds ratio of 1: the same odds on wet and dry sites
charts.threshold: A direction passes only when the interval excludes 1 and the within-site estimate lies beyond its shuffle range
charts.ruled_out: On the primary measure, odds ratios below 0.65 or above 1.75

axis.label: adjusted odds ratio, wet against dry
